component.name: blastQR
component.summary: Send files offline through QR codes

description.p: blastQR transfers files completely offline. The sender shows a sequence of QR codes on screen and the receiver scans them with its camera. The only link between the devices is the screen and the camera, which makes it useful for air-gapped computers.

ul.li: Resilient to missed frames: any large enough set of frames rebuilds the file
Up to 6 QR codes on screen at once for higher speed
Plays a tone when the transfer is done, so the sender stops automatically

screenshot.caption: Sending a file as QR codes
